content: CheckCert & SendMail This repository contains two small Go console applications (single static binaries, no runtime dependencies): CheckCert checks TLS certificates and creates <recipient>.SendMail files. SendMail watches a directory and mails the content of <recipient>.SendMail files (Go port of the C++/Qt SendMail ). websites.txt -> CheckCert -> out/zheng.bote+webcertificate@googlemail.com.SendMail -> SendMail -> SMTP CheckCert CheckCert is a small Go console application that checks the TLS certificates of a list of websites. If a certificate expires within a configurable number of days (default: 5), it creates a file <recipient>.SendMail in an output directory. This file is picked up and mailed by SendMail . Architecture The application follows the Model-View-Controller (MVC) pattern: Model ( internal/model ) : ConfigModel loads and validates the configuration from CheckCert.env ; Website / CertResult hold the data of a single check and build the notification text. View : Console output (stdout for status, stderr for errors). Controller ( internal/controller ) : CheckController reads the website list, runs the checks in parallel, evaluates the results and writes the SendMail file. Service ( internal/service ) : CertService connects via TLS (with SNI) and reads the expiry date of the server certificate. App info ( internal/config ) : rz_config.go , the Go counterpart of rz_config.hpp . Version and build date are injected via -ldflags . Workflow Initialization : Settings are loaded from CheckCert.env (next to the binary, otherwise the current directory, or via -c ). Command line options override them. Reading : The website list is parsed ( host , host:port or a URL; # comments and blank lines are ignored). Checking : All websites are checked in parallel. The expiry date is read even for already expired or untrusted certificates. Notification : For every certificate expiring within WARN_DAYS days, a line is written to <OUTPUT_DIR>/<MAIL_RECIPIENT>.SendMail : The web certificate of the website hase-zheng.net expires in 4 days. See also "openssl s_client -connect hase-zheng.net:443 </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -enddate" An existing (not yet sent) file is extended. The file is written atomically (temp file + rename), so SendMail never reads a half-written file. SendMail Architecture Model : SmtpConfigModel loads SendMail.env (same keys as the C++ version); MailMessage extracts the recipient from the file name and builds the MIME message (UTF-8, quoted-printable). View : Log output on stderr. Controller : MailController scans WATCH_DIR every POLL_SECONDS for *.SendMail files. Service : SmtpService connects via STARTTLS (or SSL/TLS on port 465), authenticates with AUTH LOGIN (fallback AUTH PLAIN ) and sends the mail. Workflow Initialization : Settings are loaded from SendMail.env (next to the binary, otherwise the current directory, or via -c ). Monitoring : WATCH_DIR is scanned immediately and then every POLL_SECONDS (default 2 s). Polling works on every file system, including network shares and removable media. Stabilization : A file is only processed once it has not been modified for STABLE_SECONDS (default 2 s). Hidden files ( .* ) are ignored. Processing : The recipient is taken from the file name ( user@example.com.SendMail -> user@example.com ), the file content becomes the mail body, the subject is SMTP_SUBJECT . Cleanup : After a successful send the file is deleted. If the file was changed while sending, it is kept (no data loss). Errors : The file is kept and retried after RETRY_SECONDS (default 300 s) - or immediately when the file changes. This avoids hammering the server, e.g. on wrong passwords. Files with an invalid recipient are kept and logged. Configuration Copy docs/SendMail.env next to the binary: SMTP_SERVER="smtp.example.com" SMTP_PORT="587" SMTP_USERNAME="user@example.com" SMTP_PASSWORD="secret_password" SMTP_FROM="sender@example.com" SMTP_STARTTLS="true" WATCH_DIR="out" # optional: SMTP_SSL, SMTP_SUBJECT, SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, POLL_SECONDS, STABLE_SECONDS, RETRY_SECONDS Credentials are never sent over an unencrypted connection (except to localhost). Usage SendMail [-c config] [-w watchdir] [-once] [-v] [watchdir] Option Description -c Configuration file -w Directory to watch (overrides WATCH_DIR ; also first argument) -once Process existing files once and exit (exit code 1 if any left) -v Show version ./build/SendMail & echo "Hello World" > out/recipient@domain.com.SendMail Run as a service: see docs/sendmail.service (systemd user unit). Stop with SIGINT/SIGTERM. Prerequisites Linux Go 1.24 or higher (build only) Build Instructions git clone https://github.com/Zheng-Bote/check-cert.git cd check-cert make # -> build/CheckCert, build/SendMail make test # unit tests CheckCert Configuration Copy docs/CheckCert.env next to the binary (or into the working directory). Relative paths are resolved relative to the .env file. WEBSITES_FILE="websites.txt" OUTPUT_DIR="../send_mail/data" # = WATCH_DIR of SendMail MAIL_RECIPIENT="zheng.bote+webcertificate@googlemail.com" WARN_DAYS="5" TIMEOUT_SECONDS="10" WORKERS="8" Variables already set in the environment take precedence over the file. CheckCert Usage CheckCert [-c config] [-l websites] [-o outdir] [-d days] [-t timeout] [-r recipient] [-v] Option Description Overrides -c Configuration file -l Website list WEBSITES_FILE -o Output directory for the SendMail file OUTPUT_DIR -d Warning threshold in days WARN_DAYS -t Timeout per connection in seconds TIMEOUT_SECONDS -r Recipient (file name) MAIL_RECIPIENT -v Show version Example websites.txt : hase-zheng.net bote.hase-zheng.net:443 https://flag-me.info/ Exit codes: 0 all OK, 1 at least one certificate expires soon, 2 usage/configuration error, 3 at least one website could not be checked. Cron 0 6 * * * /opt/CheckCert/CheckCert -c /opt/CheckCert/CheckCert.env License This project is licensed under the MIT License.
